lead.title: Australia news live: Albanese says he argued for tariff exemption in ‘productive and substantial’ call with Trump
lead.summary: PM says he also spoke with the US president about Aukus, which ‘remains full steam ahead’. He said the pair spoke about a “number of global and regional issues”, including the conflict in the Middle East and recent developments in the Pacific. Albanese said the pair spoke about the Aukus submarine deal, which “remains full steam ahead”.
